text_block_list.text: Win Variation hasn't shown up for training. While searching for her whereabouts—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...For that pas de chat, you should open your knees more.
Also, be mindful of your range of motion below the waist—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah—I'm so sorry!!
I was giving my sister ballet advice
and didn't notice you...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Apparently, there's a song my little sister can't dance to very well.
I wanted to help her out...
so I've been watching videos and practicing recently..."

"Her devotion to her little sister is admirable, but neglecting her training is unacceptable.
I give her a firm warning to make sure it doesn't happen again."
